intel_items.title: FCC bars new authorizations for devices with Covered List logic-bearing components
intel_items.summary: FCC 26-50 (Third Report & Order, ET Docket 21-232) bars new equipment authorizations for devices containing a logic-bearing hardware component produced by a Covered List entity, effective 2026-10-13. Existing authorizations are untouched. A Third FNPRM proposes extending the bar to software and firmware.

sources.excerpt_note: Order text adopting the logic-bearing component bar and proposing a firmware extension.
Explains that the rule turns on who produced the component, not the brand of the finished device.

intel_items.title: Reported FCC draft would bar new Chinese transceiver models from 3.2T
intel_items.summary: Reuters reported, citing unnamed sources, that the FCC is drafting a ban on new Chinese optical transceiver models. Sell-side commentary says it would phase in from 3.2T and exempt modules with at least 65% US-sourced BOM value. The FCC has published nothing.

sources.excerpt_note: Relays the Reuters report of an unpublished FCC draft.
Relays the 3.2T phase-in and 65% US-content figures; publication date approximate.

intel_items.notes: No primary source. The 65% figure matches the domestic end product threshold, which may be where it comes from.

intel_items.title: S.5548 would bar InnoLight and Eoptolink from federal national security systems
intel_items.summary: S.5548 was introduced on 2026-09-24 and referred to Senate HSGAC. It would bar the two firms, their subsidiaries and affiliates, and later designees from federal national security systems after a five-year transition.

sources.excerpt_note: Bill text via tracker; congress.gov page not yet pulled directly.

intel_items.notes: Confirm waiver and transition language against congress.gov before citing.

intel_items.title: InnoLight added to the 1260H list
intel_items.summary: The Department of War added InnoLight to the 1260H list on 2026-06-08 as a parent-level entry. Direct DoD contracting is barred from 2026-06-30, and procurement of the listed entities' goods from 2027-06-30.

sources.excerpt_note: Sets out the contracting and goods procurement dates.

intel_items.title: Covered List entries for foreign-produced consumer routers and connected inverters
intel_items.summary: DA 26-278 (2026-03-23) put foreign-produced consumer-grade routers on the Covered List, with a Conditional Approval path of up to 18 months. DA 26-786 (2026-07-28) did the same for connected power inverters, with a domestic end product carve-out.

sources.excerpt_note: Summarizes the router entry and its consumer-grade scope; publication date approximate.
Describes the inverter entry and the domestic end product carve-out; publication date approximate.
